items.title: Sánchez announces bank-tax extension to fund housing
items.body: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a bank-tax extension until 2027. The cabinet is due to approve it on Tuesday, November 24. Revenue would fund protected housing, tenant tax rebates, and refurbishment. The tax was due to end at the end of 2026.

items.title: Election pension pledges span payments and retirement ages
items.body: Ahead of the November 29 election, PSOE and PP propose pension rises in line with CPI. Frente Amplio would return retirement age to 65, or 60 in arduous trades. Podemos would raise minimum pensions to the SMI (minimum wage). Vox ties sustainability to a more productive economy.

items.title: Spanish candidate leads race for ECB presidency
items.body: Bank for International Settlements president Pablo Hernández de Cos is reportedly the frontrunner to lead the European Central Bank. His Dutch rival, Klaas Knot, is reportedly seen as beaten. A formal decision is expected in the week beginning November 23. He would be its first Spanish president.

items.title: UK consular voting runs until November 26
items.body: Spanish citizens on the overseas electoral register can vote in person until Thursday, November 26, for the November 29 general election. Only the consulates general in London, Manchester, and Edinburgh serve as polling sites, each for its own area. They provide ballots and document-printing help.

items.title: Costa proposes 10.2% cut to EU budget
items.body: European Council president António Costa presented a proposal on November 21 to cut the EU's draft 2028–2034 budget by 10.2%, or €180 billion. The cut is relative to the European Commission's initial proposal, at constant 2025 prices.

items.title: Unemployment subsidy offers €570 after 90 days worked
items.body: Workers with 90 days of contributions can claim a €570 monthly subsidy for three months if they qualify. With 180 days and family responsibilities, support can last up to 21 months, falling to €540 from day 181 and €480 from day 361. Applicants must register as jobseekers and request quarterly extensions.

items.title: Italian court puts Revolut under judicial administration
items.body: An Italian court has placed Revolut's activity under judicial administration for one year over weak anti-money-laundering controls; this is not a conviction. Authorities say it failed to report €41.9 million in movements between 2021 and 2026 linked to 24 people investigated or convicted of crimes.

items.title: Most workplace pension savers made no contributions
items.body: An OECD report finds that 54% of workers enrolled in Spanish company pension plans made no contributions in 2024. Some 70% contributed less than €900 over the year. This is despite the 2022 reforms.

items.title: Madrid's Teatro Real wins best opera house
items.body: Madrid's Teatro Real won Best Opera House at the International Opera Awards in Vienna on November 21. It is the theatre's second win in the main category, after 2021. Artistic director Joan Matabosch collected the award.

items.title: Catalan education unions plan November 26 strike
items.body: Education unions plan a strike in Catalonia on Thursday, November 26, demanding more staff and resources with a funded timetable. Thousands marched in Barcelona on November 21: the Guardia Urbana counted 3,000 people, while organisers reported 5,000. Unions say earlier gains have not reached all schools and remain insufficient.
